note: Revised from Emerson's (1928) description of the species, originally in English; the original describes only the soldier, and the worker, alate and nymph are not described. The second part of the same scanned page, containing the description and measurements of var. transiens, was not used. Figure numbers and locality records have been omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Larger than var. transiens, with more rounded sides of the head; the variety is smaller, with straighter sides. The original notes that von Rosen, having collected transiens in the same nest, regarded it as a variety of M. fuscotibialis subsp. libericus, but the author finds it difficult to believe that M. edentatus is merely a form of M. fuscotibialis.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, rather long; sides parallel, slightly more rounded than in var. transiens; antennae 13-segmented, the third segment smaller than the fourth, the second equal to the fourth; labrum rather long, rounded, slightly tridentate; mandibles toothless, very finely serrate, black; anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly notched, slightly deeper than in var. transiens. Measurements: head with mandibles 3.33–3.43, head width 1.23–1.30, antenna length 1.83, pronotum length 0.46, width 0.80, hind tibia 1.16, left mandible 1.27. The specimen examined was collected from the same vial as M. fuscotibialis.
